subject: English
stimulus: (a) Unless Amin read attentively, ——. (b) —— of others is a great sin. (c) The problem was too hard for ——. (d) The Headmaster does not like the students ——. (e) But for your help, ——.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) Unless Amin read attentively, he will not be able to do better in the exam. (b) To speak ill of others is a great sin. (c) The problem was too hard for me to solve. (d) The Headmaster does not like the students who do not read attentively. (e) But for your help, I could not have overcome the problem.
